cs.t: Bought a nvme SSD and failed after 3 months of use. Read similar occurrences in reviews amazon. It was a Crucial P3, now reading about Sandisk. Storage (from well known brands) used to be the most reliable component. Not sure what is going on, but feels like quality control is not as good.
cs.th: SanDisk Extreme SSDs keep abruptly failing–firmware fix for only some promised
